comment: Independent dothrow.c recipe: a gnomish Healer in debug mode wishes for '+1 egg', which sets the laid-by-you flag (spe) on a generic egg whose corpsenm is NON_PM, and throws it at the ceiling. toss_up() breaks it with hero_caused; breakobj() (dothrow.c 2526-2528) charges Luck only when ismnum(corpsenm), so ^X still reports zero luck.
